title: Benchmarking Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models in Biomedical NLP: Application, Robustness, and Self-Awareness

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting simulation studies on a two-label classification task by constructing datasets with different positive-to-negative class ratios (1:1 and 1:5) to evaluate how class imbalance impacts model predictions, classification robustness, and evaluation metrics like F1-score and AUROC.
